memory_candidates.content: Acceptance-criterion integrity when the criterion is read off a measurement script: check whether the task's own changes can alter the script's CLASSIFICATION INPUT rather than its measured subject. In BimodalLogic, scripts/measure-refactor-partitions.py derives `into_automation` by filtering an already layer-filtered `edges` list, so placing Automation at the same layer as Theorems would make every Theorems -> Automation line invisible and report zero upward edges without a single import line being deleted. A plan whose acceptance reads a derived metric must pin the metric's own configuration (here, the LAYERS table) as part of the acceptance, or rewrite the metric to scan independently of it. The general test: if the task edits the config that the measurement classifies by, the measurement can be satisfied by renumbering instead of by doing the work.
